offer.text: My maps have a blank corner where the {place_name} should be. Travel there and bring back what you see?

accept.text: Mark the landmarks well. A map is only as honest as its surveyor.

decline.text: The blank stays blank, then. Another day, perhaps.

in_progress.text: Still bound for the {place_name}? The ink is waiting.

ready.text: You've stood in the {place_name} — I can see it in your boots. The map is richer for it.

complete.text: Splendid surveying. The guild will want a copy.
